items.title: Implement G04 stale-evidence baseline group
items.context: Add a deterministic G04 smoke where all 15 rows carry stale closure evidence; the rollup must report no full roadmap claim and staleEvidenceRows=15.
items.userSees: parent-roadmap large-ledger G04 baseline smoke PASS

happy.desc: Running the G04 smoke reports 15 required rows, zero closed rows, 15 stale evidence rows, and no full roadmap completion claim.

edge.desc: The smoke asserts each stale row carries closureEvidence but mismatched stale material/story/head binding and reason code stale_closure_evidence.

adversarial.desc: The smoke asserts full completion wording is blocked while all evidence is stale, even though every required row is present.

items.title: Implement G05 deferred-rows baseline group
items.context: Add a deterministic G05 smoke where 12 rows close and 3 rows are validly deferred; the rollup must keep no full roadmap claim and expose deferredRows=3.

items.title: Implement G06 migration-sample baseline group
items.context: Add a deterministic G06 smoke where all 15 rows are migration/sample-only and cannot count as real parent completion evidence.

items.title: Implement G07 overclaim-boundary baseline group
items.context: Add a deterministic G07 smoke where local rows are otherwise closed but forbidden Authority/fullAuthority/production/independent-host wording is rejected by claim-boundary checks.

items.title: Implement G08 duplicate-or-malformed-row baseline group
items.context: Add a deterministic G08 smoke proving duplicate or malformed row IDs create invalid rows and cannot satisfy multiple user commitments.

items.title: Implement G09 child-assignment-without-delivery baseline group
items.context: Add a deterministic G09 smoke proving assignment to child stories is not delivery; incomplete/open child rows prevent full roadmap completion.

items.title: Implement G10 stale-then-refreshed recovery baseline group
items.context: Add a deterministic G10 smoke that first blocks stale evidence for all 15 rows, then refreshes evidence and permits full roadmap completion only after refresh.

items.title: Bind all groups to full 10x15 aggregate baseline and docs
items.context: Add or update the full parent-roadmap large-ledger baseline smoke so G01-G10 generate exactly 150 evaluated rows; update docs to mark the full baseline implemented only after every group command and aggregate command pass.
